title: Volcano of Circuits
description: A surreal black volcano erupts with glowing golden and bronze microchips and electronic components instead of lava. White swirling smoke rises from the crater, surrounded by floating translucent bubbles containing glowing waveforms, hearts, and abstract symbols against a dark purple and black cosmic background with colorful orbs.
prompt: Surreal digital painting of a black volcano erupting golden microchips and electronic components instead of lava.
